review.posthog_relevance: Changes dashboard card resize behavior, potentially affecting users relying on edge handles.
review.reason: P1.F4.H1 removes an 8-handle implementation and replaces it with a single bottom-right handle, changing dashboard card resize behavior. P1.F5 and P1.F55 are UI presentation and test changes. This is a localized, bounded behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is dominated by snapshot and test changes; the substantive behavior change is limited to P1.F4.H1. No runtime or backend changes are observed. The benefit is not proven, only the implementation is observed.
